verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI's multi-agent guide names "Graph based control flow" as a documented way to compose agents, alongside agent delegation and programmatic hand-off, so explicit graph composition is a first-party capability. The pack only names the graph mode, with no detail on how graphs are defined or what control-flow constructs they support. missing for 10: documented branching, loops, and parallel-step execution in graphs, graph definition API details, independent or hands-on corroboration of graph workflows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compose agents into an explicit graph or workflow with branching, loops, and parallel steps

citations.quote: There are roughly five levels of complexity when building applications with Pydantic AI: ... Agent delegation ... Programmatic agent hand-off ... Graph based control flow
"Agent delegation" refers to the scenario where an agent delegates work to another agent, then takes back control when the delegate agent ... finishes.
